Players Committee card image of [[Red Squadron 6]] (original printing), game text: “May add 1 pilot. While Ello Asty piloting, attrition against opponent is +1 here.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/redsquadron6.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
